title.en: Observed Single-Collector Uptime from System Heartbeats
title.id: Uptime Teramati Satu Kolektor dari Heartbeat Sistem

summary: Estimates observed collector availability from system heartbeat intervals within a bounded reporting period.

parameters.name: PERIOD_START
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the observation period.

parameters.name: PERIOD_END
parameters.description: Exclusive end of the observation period.

parameters.name: TIMEZONE
parameters.description: IANA timezone used to interpret both period boundaries.

parameters.name: CUSTOMER_NAME
parameters.description: Organization value used by the target FortiSIEM deployment.

parameters.name: COLLECTOR_ID
parameters.description: Numeric identifier of the collector being measured.

parameters.name: COLLECTOR_NAME
parameters.description: Reporting device name of the collector being measured.

parameters.name: HEARTBEAT_WINDOW_SECONDS
parameters.description: Maximum duration credited as observed uptime after each heartbeat.

parameters.name: TARGET_PERCENT
parameters.description: Availability target used only to derive the final status label.
